subject: science
concept: Sorting living things from nonliving things
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts physical object/creature cards into 'living' and 'nonliving' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the living things in a pictured scene
exercise.abstract: Student explains what makes something living versus nonliving

misconception_flags: classifies something that moves (like a car or cloud) as living based on movement alone

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
